name: Band Alternating V-Up
steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended straight and hold a resistance band anchored low behind your head in both hands.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs tightly.
Curl your shoulders up against the band and lift both legs, reaching your hands toward your feet.
Alternate which foot is higher while keeping your shoulders raised, then lower your legs and torso with control.
tips: Keep your lower back anchored toward the floor as each leg lowers.
Drive the crunch with your abs rather than jerking your neck forward.
